Plants of the World Online account: Delphinium ajacis L..

The native range of this species is S. Europe to W. Himalaya and Central Asia. It is an annual and grows primarily in the temperate biome. It is used to treat unspecified medicinal disorders, has environmental uses, as a medicine and for food.
